CustomField.description: Plain Text field for the Pro-Active Pipeline dashboard's use on Opportunity__c, mirroring Lead__c's Lead_Created_Quarter_Dashboard__c (named for this object instead, rather than reusing the "Lead_..." API name). No formula field or flow feeds this yet - populated manually until a source/sync process is defined. Intended values follow the same Q1=Apr-Jun ... Q4=Jan-Mar fiscal-quarter convention as the Lead__c field.
CustomField.inlineHelpText: Manually maintained, for dashboard use. Do not rely on this being automatically kept in sync.
CustomField.label: Opportunity Created Quarter Dashboard
